{"branch": "main", "commit_message": "conf: seed pipeline", "actions": [{"action": "create", "file_path": ".gitlab-ci.yml", "content": "gate:
  script:
    - |
      case "$CI_COMMIT_MESSAGE" in
        *"conf:failure"*)
          echo "verdict failure"
          exit 1
          ;;
        *"conf:hang"*)
          echo "holding until released"
          i=0
          until [ -f "/tmp/conf-release-$CI_COMMIT_SHA" ]; do
            i=$((i+1))
            if [ "$i" -gt 600 ]; then exit 1; fi
            sleep 1
          done
          ;;
      esac
      echo "verdict success"
"}]}
